Your cookware set order is still marked as shipped, so it isn’t eligible for a refund through this process yet; refunds are for delivered orders (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders). Refunds also require the item to have been received back by the shop (refund-policy/v2/return).

Cancelling or changing delivery is outside this process. Would you like me to connect you with a staff member about the order?
What can I do to get a refund instead?

Once the order is delivered, the shop must receive the cookware set back before you can request a refund. The request also needs to be made within 30 days of delivery (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders; refund-policy/v2/return; refund-policy/v2/window).
